versions.changelog: rc.3: scan the last 14 days, confirm one route, then work it through offer, test, acquisition, delivery, cashflow review, and rerank

Initial release of moneyprinter skill – routes users to targeted, ethical revenue experiments based on their current business situation.

- Diagnoses user’s real assets, constraints, stage, and speed-to-cash needs.
- Guides users through up to seven targeted intake questions, focusing on minimal and non-sensitive data.
- Produces a concise Revenue Profile using only known facts, clear assumptions, or open questions.
- Recommends one main and one fallback revenue experiment, scoring up to three possible routes.
- Outputs an actionable Experiment Brief with predefined headings, prioritizing fast, testable actions.
- Includes strong safety, privacy, and ethical constraints—never acts externally without explicit user approval.
